prompt: A desktop landing page for Quatro Ventos, edge to edge, crisp readable Portuguese text, no browser window and no device frame. A technical buyer comparing agencies must see the offer and start a quote. The screen is a white cleanroom interface, not a photograph of a room. One dominant object: a single framed website specimen, a flat white panel showing a real page layout, sitting alone in a large empty field. Behind it, enormous ink type reads Design, Code, Test, Repeat... A tiny caption reads Estamos prontos para criar, programar e cuidar do seu site. One small control on the specimen reads Faça um orçamento sem compromisso! Along the bottom, six identical thin instrument stations labeled Arquitetura, Prototipagem, Frontend, Backend, Homologação, Entrega. Only Arquitetura has a teal status lamp lit. Header: Quatro Ventos at left, navigation Desenvolvimento de sites, Manutenção de sites, Hospedagem, Suporte at the right. Ground #FDFFFC. Ink #011627. The only teal #2EC4B6 is that one lamp and the quote control. Light grotesque, one phrase huge, labels tiny. No cards, no testimonials, no laptop photo.
